Definition: an Arkite or inhabitant of Erek
BiblicalUsage: The Arkite is a family of the Canaanites, named twice, in the table of nations and in the chronicler's copy of it. The name marks one of the peoples who lived in the land before Israel, descended from Canaan the son of Ham.
TheologicalSignificance: One family name in a table of nations carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the record, that the land had its peoples before Israel came, and God knew them all by name.
